meta.title: biolyn
meta.description: One link for everything you share. Put it in your Instagram bio.

common.uploadFailed: Could not upload that picture. Try a JPG or PNG.

home.intro: Turn that single link into a page with all your links, your socials and stats on what people actually tap.
home.signInOptions: Continue with Google or get a magic link by email.
home.statsText: Views over 7 or 30 days, clicks on each link and the sites your visitors came from.
home.qrText: Download a card with your QR code for stories, flyers and your shop counter.
home.themesText: Pick the look that fits you and switch whenever your style changes.
home.socialsText: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more, as clean icons under your name.
home.manageText: Add, edit and drag your links into order from one simple dashboard.
home.stepsTitle: From sign up to bio in minutes.
home.step2: your links, photo, socials and theme
home.finalTitle: Claim your name before it's gone.

notFound.title: Nothing here yet
notFound.text: This page doesn't exist, or nobody has claimed this username. It could be yours.

login.title: Sign in to biolyn
login.intro: Claim your link or pick up where you left off. No password needed.
login.checkText: We sent a sign-in link to <email></email>. Open it in this same browser.
login.linkFailed: Sign-in didn't finish. The email link may have expired or been used already, or Google sign-in was cancelled. Try again.
login.tooMany: Too many sign-in emails were sent recently. Use the newest link already in your inbox, or wait an hour and try again.
login.googleDown: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Use email instead.

report.title: Report a page
report.intro: Tell us what breaks the rules on this page. The owner won't see who reported it.
report.emailPlaceholder: Only if you want us to follow up
report.sent: The report was sent and we'll review this page.

dashboard.pickText: This becomes your link, for example biolyn.link/yourname.
dashboard.hiddenText: It was reported for breaking the rules. You can still edit it, but visitors can't see it.
dashboard.profileText: Your picture, name and bio sit at the top of your page.
dashboard.contentText: Everything on your page, in order. Tap the pencil to edit, drag ⋮⋮ to move things, or tap ⋯ for more. On a phone, press and hold ⋮⋮ first.
dashboard.socialsText: Shown as icons under your name. Leave a field empty to remove it.
dashboard.themeText: How your public page looks to visitors.
dashboard.fontText: Used for everything on your public page: name, bio and links.
dashboard.cornersText: The shape of every block on your public page: buttons, big links, players and photos.

photoStyleHints.round: A small round picture above your name.
photoStyleHints.cover: A big photo across the top that fades into your page.

forms.coverTip: Tip: choose your picture again to frame it for the tall cover shape.

bio.label: Bio
bio.selectFirst: Select words first to turn them into the link.
bio.badLink: Use a web address, like example.com.
bio.count: {count}/{max} characters. Select words to make them bold, italic, underlined, crossed out or a link.

cropper.title: Frame your picture
cropper.help: Drag the picture to move it. Pinch or scroll on it to zoom.
cropper.failed: Could not open that picture. Try a JPG or PNG.
cropper.preview: Picture preview. Use the arrow keys to move it and + or - to zoom.

addItem.chooseTitle: What do you want to add?
addItem.linkHint: A button to any website, video or song
addItem.carouselHint: Up to {max} photos, as a carousel or a grid
addItem.sectionHint: A title with links under it, as a list or a row of cards

linkForm.title: Title
linkForm.detected: {service, select, youtube {This is a YouTube link!} spotify {This is a Spotify link!} other {This is an Apple Music link!}}
linkForm.asPlayer: Show it as a player on your page
linkForm.previewWait: Getting the preview can take a few seconds.
linkForm.cropped: Your picture is cropped to a wide 16:9 shape.
linkForm.iconUsed: This site has no preview picture, so its icon is used.
linkForm.pictureHint: Optional. Upload your own picture, or use the link's preview.

sectionForm.title: Section title
sectionForm.titleHint: Optional. It shows above the links.
sectionForm.carouselHint: Cards in a row that people swipe.
sectionForm.carouselTip: Tip: give these links a picture. It shows on each card.

linkList.empty: Nothing here yet. Tap Add to make your first link, section or photo carousel.
linkList.noPhotos: No photos yet, hidden on your page
linkList.emptySection: No links yet, hidden on your page
linkList.deleteSectionText: {count, plural, one {Its link can stay on your page, or go with it.} other {Its # links can stay on your page, or go with it.}}

photos.required: Required: a JPG, PNG or WebP picture. A description is optional and helps people who use screen readers.
photos.empty: No photos yet. Until you add some, this gallery stays hidden on your page.
photos.failedOne: One photo could not be uploaded. Try a JPG or PNG.
photos.failedMany: {count} photos could not be uploaded. Try JPG or PNG files.
photos.leftOut: A gallery holds {max} photos, so some were left out.

stats.noVisits: No visits yet. Share your link to start seeing data.
stats.shareText: A picture with your QR code to post in a story or print on flyers, menus or your shop counter. Scanning it opens your page.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.proHint: Pick what to see and compare.
analytics.simpleHint: Who visits your page and what they tap.
analytics.inLast: {metric, select, clicks {clicks} other {views}} in the last {n} days
analytics.chartLabel: Line chart of {metric, select, clicks {clicks} other {views}} per day from {from} to {to}. Use the left and right arrow keys to read each day, or show the numbers as a table.
analytics.noData: No {metric, select, clicks {clicks} other {views}} in this range yet

sources.title: Tracking links
sources.text: Make a separate link for each place you share your page, like your TikTok bio or a flyer. Analytics then shows how many people came from each one.
sources.visits: {count, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} in the last 30 days
sources.full: You have the most tracking links. Delete one to add another.
sources.deleteText: People who still use this link will count as “Direct or unknown”. The visits it already brought stay in Analytics, marked as deleted.

card.dialogText: Visits from this card count for {name} in Analytics.

errors.usernameFormat: Use 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dots or underscores.
errors.bioTooFormatted: Your bio has too much formatting. Remove some of it.
errors.linkMissing: Add a title and a URL.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time.
errors.badProtocol: Links must start with http:// or https://.
errors.privateHost: Use a public website address, not a local or IP address.
errors.unsafe: Google Safe Browsing flags this link as unsafe, so it can't be added.
errors.pictureFailed: Could not use that picture. Upload it again.
errors.linksTooFast: You're adding links very fast. Wait a few minutes.
errors.maxLinks: You can have up to {max} links.
errors.previewsTooFast: Too many previews. Wait a few minutes.
errors.noPreview: Could not find a preview for this link. Add a picture instead.
errors.socialHandle: {platform}: use a handle like @name or a full URL.
errors.itemsTooFast: You're adding things very fast. Wait a few minutes.
errors.maxItems: You can have up to {max} items.
errors.maxGalleries: You can have up to {max} photo galleries.
errors.photosTooFast: You're adding photos very fast. Wait a few minutes.
errors.maxGalleryPhotos: A gallery can have up to {max} photos.
errors.maxPagePhotos: Your page can have up to {max} photos.
errors.maxSources: You can have up to {max} tracking links.
errors.sourceExists: You already have a link with that name.
errors.sourceSaveFailed: Could not save the tracking link.
errors.sourceNameMissing: Give the link a name, like TikTok.
errors.sourceNameEmpty: Use at least one letter or number in the name.
errors.reportEmail: That email doesn't look right. You can leave it empty.
errors.reportFailed: Could not send the report. Try again.
errors.reportTooMany: You've sent several reports already. Try again later.
errors.sectionGone: That section no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.sectionFull: A section can hold up to {max} links.
errors.maxSections: You can have up to {max} sections.
